compute_cross_product: compute the cross product of two 3-element arrays with a specified axis using the cross function
calculate_vecdot: calculate the vector dot product of two arrays along a given axis with proper broadcasting support
solve_linear_system: solve a linear system of equations x1 @ x = x2 using the solve function with shape workarounds
compute_matrix_trace: compute the trace of a matrix with an optional diagonal offset and output dtype
compute_vector_norm: compute the norm of a vector with a specified order, axis, and keepdims options
